newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 23.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- All Nippon Airways Co Ltd honorary chairman Tokuji Wakasa to resign from board of directors.
-- Sony Corp to cut number of directors from 38 to 10.
-- Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd names vice president Ichiro Fujita as new president.
-- Draft report calls for closer Japan-U.S. defence links.
-- Lower House approves bills on nursing care for elderly.
-- Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd to introduce mandatory retirement age for senior advisers.
-- Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) to set international rules on electronic money transactions.
